articles.title: Indian Army creates 'modern warfare force' with over one lakh drone operatives, new Special Forces Bhairav raised for modern warfare
articles.summary: The Indian Army has significantly enhanced its modern warfare capabilities, establishing a new 'modern warfare force'. This strategic initiative includes training over one lakh drone operatives, underscoring a shift towards technology-driven combat. Additionally, a new Special Forces unit named 'Bhairav' has been raised, specifically designed for modern conflict scenarios. These advancements are crucial for strengthening India's defence readiness and adapting to contemporary threats.

articles.title: North Korea launches ballistic missiles toward sea ahead of South Korean leader’s visit to China
articles.summary: North Korea launched multiple ballistic missiles into the sea on Sunday, just hours before South Korea's president departed for China. These crucial talks are expected to address North Korea's escalating nuclear program. This provocative act underscores persistent regional tensions and highlights the urgent need for international diplomatic efforts to ensure stability and security in Northeast Asia, a key concern for global defense strategy.
